Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, where Driver 1 was stopped in traffic when the front of
Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear bumper of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy for that
vehicle. A passenger, identified in this report only as Passenger, was seated in the front right position and reported
pain in the left knee after the impact. Responding officers confirmed Passenger was present in the vehicle at the time
of the crash, and both drivers and two independent witnesses gave consistent accounts of how the collision
happened. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and the front of Driver 2's
vehicle, and the extent of that damage fits the reported force of the impact. Driver 1 stated the car had no prior
damage that he was aware of, and nothing observed at the scene suggested otherwise. The knee injury described by
Passenger is consistent with the way a passenger's leg would strike the dashboard or lower console in a collision of
this kind. Passenger was transported for evaluation, and the report will be updated if additional information becomes
available.
